name: local/looksmax-i18n
description: Locale negotiation, the language switcher, per-locale document metadata and the translation tooling for Looksmax.lat.

flarum-extension.title: Looksmax i18n
//optional-dependencies: Declares that this extension overrides strings from
flarum-lang/spanish, so the pack cannot be disabled without
flagging that these overrides go with it.
NOTE: this does NOT control boot order. Flarum reads the field
extensions_enabled array, so it does not reorder anything —
which is why the overrides in locale/es.yml were dead until
src/LastWordProvider.php was added to re-register them last.
